## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Treatment Product
where: ReportService (uses), src/business/reportService.ts, component business

=====SOURCE-BEGIN

response.rationale: No, these are two different concepts. A, Treatment Product, is a catalog entry: a named product looked up by id. In ReportService (node a663bd12cbc0090c, src/business/reportService.ts) the code `const productNames = new Map(this.products.findAll().map((p) => [p.id, p.name]));` builds a map from product id to product name. B, Treatment, is a record of a treatment being applied. TreatmentRepository (node b2566037ba6b6900, src/persistence/repositories.ts) stores `private readonly items: TreatmentRecord[] = [];`, and the graph shows it is queried per hive through findByHive. ReportService calls both TreatmentProductRepository.findAll and TreatmentRepository.findByHive, which means the two are separate repositories for separate things. A treatment most likely refers to a product, but a product and the event of applying it are not the same real-world thing.
